name: tracker-yuto.vercel
description:
Overview: A modern, sleek web application designed to track and manage daily personal finances, income, and expenses efficiently.

Core Features:

Real-time calculation of total balance, total income, and total expenses.

Easy categorization of transactions (e.g., food, transport, shopping, healthcare, housing, and salary).

Filter options to seamlessly view all transactions, expenses, or income separately.

Data Storage: Uses browser LocalStorage to save all financial records locally, ensuring data safety even after refreshing or closing the browser tab.

Export Capability: Features a built-in PDF export tool (html2pdf) that lets users generate and download neat financial summary reports.
